payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and approaches for extracting textual patterns used in artificial error generation (AEG).

claims.text: Textual patterns are extracted from an annotated corpus to insert errors into grammatically correct sentences.
Patterns are learned from incorrect and correct sentence pairs, capturing transformations in the form of (incorrect phrase, correct phrase).
The patterns include word forms and part-of-speech tags, allowing for the generation of various types of errors.
A total of 35,625 patterns were identified from the training data for generating errors.
